fixture_scope: completed MQ01/MQ02 and previously seen arrival only

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: They're here. Caelan, would you meet them by the lower bridge? Bring them in when they're ready.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Regent Iselin? Mother Serene sent me. I’m Caelan.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Thank you, Caelan. Have we kept her waiting?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Mother Serene is expecting you.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Then we’ve arrived at a very good moment.

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: *under his breath* Finally.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: *glances back with a tired smile* Yes. I heard that.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: This is Lucan Rooke, my guard. Lucan, Caelan is showing us in.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Through the courtyard?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Yes. Then through the hall to the dining room.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Good. I’ll follow behind.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: That’s an unusual sword.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Mira made it. She gave it to me this morning.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: This morning?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: An early birthday present.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Keep it clear of the gatepost. You’re wearing it wider than you think.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: *adjusts the scabbard* Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: This way.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Welcome. Come and sit down.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Thank you for receiving us.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: You look as though you could use something warm.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: I could use several things, but that’s comfortably the first.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Caelan, would you pass the bread?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: Here you are.

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Were you working the brake coming down the ridge?

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: Indeed! Most of the way down.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: How do you stop the wagon getting ahead of the horses?

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: Keep it slow before it starts. Once a loaded wagon’s running, you’ve left yourself very little to work with.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Does the brake press against both wheels?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: *slides the bread toward him* You were going to make sure everyone remembered to eat.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: I can ask while I’m eating.

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: *chuckles* Ask away.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: *looks at Lucan* Are you watching the door?

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Among other things.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Even while you’re eating?

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Her ladyship chose me because I can manage both.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Thank you for the wonderful meal and company. Now if I may, shall we discuss the matter of our visit?

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Of course. Caelan, please take these plates.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: I’ve got them.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Elden Vale Sanctuary is one of the last remaining untapped deposits, and we are in need of its resources to hasten repairs around the region.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: What about the other quarries?

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: They are already mined day and night, but we can't keep up with the demand. The same thing that happened here to the bridge is happening across Merovar.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Couldn’t the crown send more?

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Would that she could, but alas.

dialogue.speaker: tomas
dialogue.text: Aren't you Her Majesty's sister? Why would she say no?

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: People haven’t been refusing me, Tomas. They still have to cut the stone and bring it. There are other communities waiting for the same loads.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: A nearer source would give us more room to work. The proposed rock face is clear of the standing Sanctuary's walls.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Yes, but the protected ground covers more than just the walls of the Sanctuary.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: I know. I believe we can preserve the grounds while mining the deposit. I wouldn’t have brought you the proposal otherwise.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: The Sanctuary was built there to guide the region’s dead back to the planet. We do not know what lies beneath the aetherial confluence there. It is simply too risky.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Could that work continue if we kept the crews away from the hall and grove?

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: No, it would disrupt our duty to the dead.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Alas, there are living people waiting for these roads.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Their families depend on us for this as well.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: There is also a danger your survey does not show. The caretakers have heard growling inside the cave recently.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Since when?

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Since the incident at the bridge. They closed the entrance and have been keeping people away.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Has anyone been hurt?

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: None that the caretakers have reported. I want the entrance left alone while they find out what is inside.

dialogue.speaker: regent_survivor
dialogue.text: Your ladyship—the men at the Sanctuary…

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: What happened?

dialogue.speaker: regent_survivor
dialogue.text: Something came out of the cave. We couldn’t get everyone away.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: What men...?

dialogue.speaker: regent_survivor
dialogue.text: The advance party. We were marking out the Crown’s working ground.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: You’ve already sent men into the reserve!?

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Ahead of my visit. To secure the deposit and prepare the mining work.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: You sent them without telling me?

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: The order came from Her Majesty...and they weren’t supposed to enter the cave.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: You came asking for my agreement knowing about those orders.

dialogue.speaker: regent_survivor
dialogue.text: Please… the others are still there.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Is the road clear?

dialogue.speaker: regent_survivor
dialogue.text: It was when I left.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Then we move. Now.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Easy. Tomas, water and clean cloths.

dialogue.speaker: regent_driver
dialogue.text: I’ll help you tend him.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: I’ll get Mira. She has her kit—we can help the wounded.

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Find the caretakers when you arrive. Help where you can, but stay clear of the cave.

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Page, bring the survey. Stay with us.

dialogue.speaker: iselin
dialogue.text: Mother Serene—

dialogue.speaker: serene
dialogue.text: Bring them back safely, Iselin. We will speak when you return.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Caelan? What's going on?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: A crew’s been attacked at the Sanctuary. There are still people up there.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: *sets down her tools* Attacked by what?

dialogue.speaker: lucan
dialogue.text: Something from the cave. The man who reached us couldn’t give a clear account.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Are the caretakers safe?

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: We need to find out.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Then I’m coming. Give me a moment.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: All right. Lead the way.

event.reason: Caelan and Mira are needed at the Sanctuary.
